cases.description: 紙盒四步折疊組裝（AI案例示範）
cases.applied_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: web-quality website command example. Apply /assembly steps: Build the subject through clear numbered assembly stages. Reference image supplies subject identity only. Four numbered panels 1 2 3 4 showing generic hinged-lid mint paper carton from flat scored blank to raised sidewalls to folded bottom tabs to finished closed cube with leaf. Clear progression arrows left to right. Title CONCEPT ASSEMBLY; not actual factory dieline and no dimensions. Square composition, professional layout, preserve recognizable reference subject, no watermarks, no copied advertising, no unintended text. Prioritize correct labels, counts, arrows and physically coherent structure. CRITICAL ordered progression: panel 1 fully flat blank; panel 2 ONLY rear and two side walls raised, FRONT WALL STILL FLAT ON TABLE; panel 3 all four walls fully raised and bottom tabs folded, LID OPEN; panel 4 lid closed leaf cube. Panels 2 and 3 must not be reversed. Read in two-by-two grid 1 top left 2 top right 3 bottom left 4 bottom right. No extra arrows required. PANEL 3 MUST have a FULL HEIGHT FRONT WALL, equal height to side walls, hiding the interior floor. It is the same finished cube as panel 4 but with rear hinged lid up. Do not draw low front lip or open-front tray. Four distinct proper stages.

Three-quarter view on seamless warm white studio surface, whole box visible with breathing room, soft contact shadow. Design concept only, not an existing branded package. Square web-quality photo.
